title: Result of config.apply (v1.0)
description: Request args: {"set": {key: value, ...}} with 1 to 16 keys. Every key, value and authorization is checked before any is written; a failed check answers invalid or refused with error "<reason>:<key>" and nothing is written. Writes are then made in order; a write that still fails is reported here and the others stand.

applied.description: key -> ok | failed. Never the value.

restarting.description: A write (connectivity.mode) makes the device restart shortly after this result.
